comment: The simulator capability matrix, read by the collector (SimulatorCatalog.cs, built in) and the website (src/lib/simulators.ts). status: supported = an adapter exists and has been tested; documented = channels read from the publisher's own documentation, and an adapter may exist that's still being checked, whose channels are marked collected one at a time as they're confirmed in the game, while its laps are still refused; minAdapterVersion (optional) = laps from an older adapter of that simulator are refused, as their files aren't in the form the site reads; interfaceIdentified = interface found, channels not checked. support: collected, collectedAfterStint, documented (not yet confirmed in the simulator), unavailable, unknown (treat like unavailable). Only change a simulator to supported once its adapter has passed docs/multi-simulator.md's checklist against the real simulator. Researched 2026-11-01.

interfaces.name: Local\acpmf_physics, Local\acpmf_graphics, Local\acpmf_static
interfaces.note: The same names as Assetto Corsa and AC Rally, and AC's static page starts the same way, so only the process tells them apart (ACC's is AC2-Win64-Shipping.exe). Layout: the document's fields in its order, 4-byte aligned (wchar_t arrays padded to 4), physics 800 bytes, graphics 1588, static 820; collector/RacingCoach.Collector.Core/AccSharedMemory.cs

simulators.licensing: Kunos publishes the shared memory documentation for tool makers, and confirmed to the site owner on 2026-11-06 that RacingCoach.app may use it.
sources: ACC Shared Memory v1.8.12 (Kunos): https://github.com/rrennoir/PyAccSharedMemory/blob/main/ACCSharedMemoryDocumentationV1.8.12.pdf (a copy, SHA-256 a0c279753f154e9145f6854313472a0e1270027057ce27e2db1547a63f56cabf; the original is at https://www.assettocorsa.net/forum/index.php?threads/acc-shared-memory-documentation.59965/). Offsets worked out from it on 2026-11-04 and compared with PyAccSharedMemory's reader, which walks the same fields with the same padding. The document gives no offsets or units for several fields, and its car appendices stop at the 2022 Challengers Pack. A later contributor reports running shared memory v1.9 without finding newer documentation: check smVersion in the static page.

speed.note: speedKmh, in km/h. Spa recording 2026-11-05: matches localVelocity's forward axis

lapDistance.note: distanceTraveled is the stint's, and trackSplineLength is marked not used, so no meters along the lap

lapDistancePct.note: normalizedCarPosition. Spa recording 2026-11-05: 0 to 1, wrapping at the line

longAccel.note: accG z, the car's own g (+ forward), despite the document saying global coordinates. Spa recording 2026-11-05: negative under braking

latAccel.note: accG x, the car's own g (+ left). Spa recording 2026-11-05: 1.4 g through La Source, matching speed × yaw rate

vertAccel.note: accG y, in g without gravity, so 1 g is added to match iRacing's VertAccel. Spa recording 2026-11-05: averages 0.02 g on the move

yaw.note: heading, radians. Spa recording 2026-11-05: it grows turning right, so it's negated to match iRacing's Yaw. Spa 18:36: 0 is ACC's world +z (heading is atan2(-x, z) of the world velocity to 0.05 rad), not north; the website finds Yaw's zero from each lap's positions

yawRate.note: localAngularVel y, + left. Spa recording 2026-11-05: negative through La Source, tracks lateral g

velocityLocal.note: localVelocity: z forward, x left. Spa recording 2026-11-05: z reaches top speed in m/s; x's sign is consistent with the turns but less certain

worldPosition.note: carCoordinates by playerCarID, written as WorldX/WorldY/WorldZ from adapter 4. Spa recording 2026-11-05: meters, a new value every physics step, 6938 m round the lap, y up (102 m from lowest to highest); x and z are mirrored against east and north (La Source turns left and the lap runs anticlockwise when x is east), so east, north is (-x, z) turned. The website places them on the mapped iRacing track (src/lib/worldAlignment.ts)

geoPosition.note: No latitude or longitude, so no satellite maps or GPS driving lines

brake.note: Spa recording 2026-11-05: 0 to 1, tracks negative longitudinal g

clutch.note: Engagement like iRacing's Clutch, despite the document calling it a pedal input. Spa recording 2026-11-05: 1.00 throughout driving

steeringAngle.note: From adapter 3: steerAngle (-1 to 1) times half the driver's wheel rotation, which the shared memory doesn't give, so only when the collector is given it (--steering-range, e.g. 900; remembered in collector.json), and empty otherwise. Spa 18:36: full lock read ±0.752, not ±1, so the input is a share of the wheel's range, not of the car's lock (Appendix 5, AccCars.cs). As a share of 900°, La Source is 216°, a GT3's steering ratio against the front wheels' angle from yaw rate and speed; as a share of the Huracán's 310° it would be 6:1. Wrong if ACC's own Steer Lock setting differs from the range given

steeringInput.note: steerAngle, -1 to 1, + right, negated to + left. Spa recording 2026-11-05: +0.48 through La Source; full right lock still to be seen

gear.note: 0 reverse, 1 neutral, 2 first. Spa recording 2026-11-05: 1 standing still, 2 pulling away, 7 at the top of a six-speed car

rpm.note: rpm. Spa recording 2026-11-05: up to 8662 against the static page's maxRpm 8650

absActive.note: abs; absInAction is marked not used. Spa 18:36: only 0 or 1, in bursts under braking, trail braking included

tirePressure.note: wheelPressure, in psi. Spa recording 2026-11-05: 26-27 hot

tireCoreTemp.note: TyreCoreTemp, one value per tire; a different thing from iRacing's three carcass values

wheelSpeed.note: wheelAngularSpeed in rad/s; tyreRadius is marked not shown

slipRatio.note: Documented in radians, which isn't what a ratio is: confirm what it holds before showing it

fuelLevel.note: fuel, in liters though the document says kg. Spa 18:36: 62 with fuelXLap (documented liters) 4.24 and fuelEstimatedLaps 14.6 = 62 / 4.24, and the Huracán's maxFuel 120 is its 120 L tank. ACC burned none in either Spa session (usedFuel stayed 0), so it's flat until a session that uses fuel

fuelUse.note: fuelXLap is per lap, not a rate: don't convert it without a test

engineDamage.note: carDamage is by side of the car; no engine value

lapNumber.note: completedLaps. Spa recording 2026-11-05: goes up at the line

lapTime.note: iLastTime, in ms. Spa recording 2026-11-05: matches the time between line crossings

lapValid.note: isValidLap. Spa 18:36: false from going off the track; ACC resets it at the line, sometimes a read before it counts the lap, so AccFrameBuilder latches it from the line

pitLane.note: isInPitLane. Spa recording 2026-11-05: on in the pit lane, off once out

weather.note: airTemp and roadTemp in °C (Spa 18:36: 27.4 and 28.8). windSpeed and windDirection read 0 in both Spa sessions, so they're left out until wind is seen; rain is an intensity level only; no humidity

incidents.note: No such count; numberOfTyresOut is marked not used, so off-track needs another source too

trackId.note: track; trackConfiguration is marked not used

carId.note: carModel, Kunos's id (e.g. porsche_991ii_gt3_r); the document's Appendix 2 names them up to the 2022 Challengers Pack

driverId.note: Names only; no stable account id

fieldCars.note: Positions and car IDs only: no names, times or running order here

simulators.minAdapterVersionNote: Adapter 2 (collector 1.93.0) has the conventions the Spa recording of 2026-11-10 proved: the clutch as engagement, the steering angle from the wheel rotation, off track, and laps that start at AC's own count. Adapter 1's laps are refused.

speed.note: speedKmh, km/h. Spa recording 2026-11-10: matches localVelocity's forward axis (45.72 against 45.73 m/s on average)

lapDistance.note: Not in the document; the spline position times trackSPlineLength would be worked out, not given

lapDistancePct.note: normalizedCarPosition. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 0 to 1; AC counts the lap at 0.0005, 4 reads past the spline's 0, so the lap position counts from there and the reads before the count stay with the lap before (AcFrameBuilder.ForLapFile)

longAccel.note: accG z, the car's own g (+ forward). Spa recording 2026-11-10: the change of speed is 9.74 m/s² per g of it (r = 0.99)

latAccel.note: accG x, the car's own g (+ left). Spa recording 2026-11-10: yaw rate times speed is 9.90 m/s² per g of it (r = 0.99)

vertAccel.note: accG y, in g without gravity, so 1 g is added to match iRacing's VertAccel. Spa recording 2026-11-10: averages 0.02 g on the move

yaw.note: heading, radians, growing turning right, so negated to match iRacing's Yaw. Spa recording 2026-11-10: the direction of travel in carCoordinates is atan2(x, z) = -heading

yawRate.note: localAngularVel y, + left. Spa recording 2026-11-10: the negative of heading's change; negative through La Source

velocityLocal.note: localVelocity: z forward, x left. Spa recording 2026-11-10: the world velocity turned into the car by heading matches x to r = 0.99998; z negative in reverse

worldPosition.note: carCoordinates, the player's car, as WorldX/WorldY/WorldZ. Spa recording 2026-11-10: meters (6950 m round the lap, 102 m of climb), y up, turning as ACC's, so the website's fit to iRacing's outline applies

brake.note: brake. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 0 to 1, with negative longitudinal g

clutch.note: Engagement like iRacing's Clutch, despite the document calling it the pedal. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 1 driving, 0 standing still with the automatic clutch open

steeringAngle.note: steerAngle (-1 to 1) times half the driver's wheel rotation set in AC's controls, which the shared memory doesn't give, so only when the collector is given it (--steering-range or collector.json's steeringRange, 900 by default). Spa recording 2026-11-10: La Source 171° at 900°, as ACC's Spa recordings

steeringInput.note: steerAngle, -1 to 1, + right, negated to + left. Spa recording 2026-11-10: +0.48 at La Source, runs against the yaw rate (r = -0.96); 1.0 at the off

gear.note: 0 reverse, 1 neutral, 2 first, as documented. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 0 reversing in the pit box, 7 at the top of the six-speed 488; neutral for a read or two in a shift, bridged

rpm.note: rpms. Spa recording 2026-11-10: up to 8031 against the static page's maxRpm 8000

absActive.note: abs is the ABS setting's slip ratio limit, not ABS working

tirePressure.note: wheelsPressure, psi. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 24.6 on blanket-warm tyres set to 16 cold, 20-24 on track

tireSurfaceTemp.note: tyreTempI/M/O: inner, middle, outer. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 80 °C on blanket-warm tyres, then 60-82 on track, apart across the tyre as surface temperatures are. No frame field yet

tireCarcassTemp.note: See tireSurfaceTemp; tyreCoreTemperature is the core, one value per tyre

slipRatio.note: wheelSlip, "spin speed of each tyre": what it holds unconfirmed

rideHeightAxle.note: rideHeight[2], front and rear. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 0.073 and 0.083 standing still, so meters. No frame field yet

fuelLevel.note: fuel, liters. Red Bull Ring (National) recording 2026-11-10, fuel use on: 30 at the start, about 1.2 a lap (a GT3's 2.3 km lap), back to 30 at the restart; the static page's maxFuel 110 is the 488's tank. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 30 throughout, with fuel use off

lapNumber.note: completedLaps. Spa recording 2026-11-10: goes up at the timing line. Red Bull Ring recording 2026-11-10: back to 0 at the restart, which starts a new session (S1)

lapTime.note: iLastTime, ms. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 152163 for the lap AC showed as 2:32.163, matching the time between its counts

pitLane.note: isInPitLane, isInPit. Spa recording 2026-11-10: on in the pit lane and the box, off once out

weather.note: airTemp and roadTemp in °C. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 26 and 34, as the game showed. windSpeed (4.55, no unit) and windDirection (305) are left out until their units are known

incidents.note: No incident count. numberOfTyresOut gives off track (all 4 wheels out, as iRacing's OffTrack; Spa recording 2026-11-10: 3, then 4 for 1.2 s at the off), which marks the lap as off track

sessionType.note: session. Both recordings of 2026-11-10: 0, Practice, as driven

trackId.note: track and trackConfiguration (folder names), sent as track/layout. Red Bull Ring recording 2026-11-10: ks_red_bull_ring and layout_national, trackSPlineLength 2317 m; Spa's configuration is empty. The static page still holds the last session's track until AC loads the next

trackLength.note: trackSPlineLength, meters. Spa recording 2026-11-10: 6946 at Spa (iRacing's 7004)

fieldCars.note: The pages hold only the player's car
